A small '''skirmish''' occurred on the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] world of [[Carida/Legends|Carida]] shortly before the completion of the [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]] in [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]], the result of a small Rebel force attempting to interfere with the demonstration of [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Maximilian Veers/Legends|Maximilian Veers']] demonstration of a new model of [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|AT-AT]] [[Walker/Legends|walker]].

==The battle==
With the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]] construction on schedule, [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] became invested in the research and development of other weapons to further the Empire's aims. To this end, he planned to observe the demonstration on Carida, and Palpatine ordered both [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] and [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] [[Wilhuff Tarkin/Legends|Wilhuff Tarkin]] to witness the demonstration, despite their protests.

With at least seventeen [[Field Commander/Legends|field commanders]] from the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] observing, Veers moved his vehicle through an armored barrier, destroying it in a few steps. There, the blasters of his walker easily destroyed two captured Rebel [[T2-B Repulsor Tank/Legends|T2-B repulsor tanks]] and a pair of [[T4-B heavy tank]]s, in addition to three antiquated [[All Terrain Attack Pod/Legends|pod walkers]] meeting a similar fate. Veers moved down to the river and deployed a squad of nine [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] from the AT-AT. In this leg of the demonstration, Veers' walker killed least nine captured [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] soldiers, as well as a captive [[Rancor/Legends|rancor]].

Before the demonstration could continue, a force of [[Rebel trooper/Legends|Rebel troopers]] and T2-B repulsor tanks attacked Veers' walker and the Imperial field commanders. Despite the surprise of their incursion, Veers remained calm and quickly dispatched the small force.

==Aftermath==
{{Dialogue|Tarkin|Colonel Veers is of the opinion that the Rebel base that launched the attack could not be far away based on the size of their force.|Darth Vader|I have used his information to pinpoint Jabiim as the likely origin point. Allow me to take a force there and crush them once and for all!|Palpatine|More important than destroying their worthless base of operations is finding the identity of the one who revealed the location of this demonstration, my apprentice.|attr=[[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] [[Wilhuff Tarkin/Legends|Tarkin]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] and [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]|src=<ref name="EaW" />}}

Palpatine congratulated Veers on the AT-AT's success. [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] along with Veers calculated that the planet [[Jabiim/Legends|Jabiim]] provided the staging point for the attack. Although Tarkin stated that the AT-AT would see little use other than [[garrison]] duty when the Death Star was operational, Palpatine foresaw that the AT-AT would be "even more successful" than Tarkin could imagine. 

==Behind the scenes==
This battle was the seventh mission of the Imperial campaign in the [[2006]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Empire at War]]''. Although not outright stated in the game, it is implied that the Rebels were able to land on the heavily-guarded world of Carida due to the traitor [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Kalast]], whose work in aiding the Rebel Alliance was a key narrative thread throughout the game's Imperial campaign.
